title: AC1 - Login form is available at Signup/Login page

steps.expected: Login form is displayed with email and password fields

steps.step: Verify form contains email input field, password input field, and login button
steps.expected: All required form elements are present and visible

title: AC2 - Valid credentials log user into the application

steps.step: Enter valid registered user email in email field
Enter correct password in password field

steps.expected: User is redirected to dashboard/homepage with personalized features visible
Credentials are entered in respective fields
Redirect to homepage/dashboard with user authenticated

title: AC3 - Invalid credentials show error message

steps.step: Enter registered user email with incorrect password
Verify user remains on login page
steps.expected: User is not logged in and can retry

title: AC4 - Empty email field shows validation warning

steps.step: Leave email field empty and enter password

steps.expected: 'Required field' or 'Email is required' validation message is displayed for email field

steps.step: Leave email field empty and enter valid password
steps.expected: Email is empty, password is entered
'Required field' validation message is displayed for email field
